content.short: Switch settles USDC and USDT across 30+ local currencies with same-day settlement.
content.description: Switch moves stablecoins in and out of more than thirty local currencies, settling in minutes rather than the days a correspondent banking transfer would take. Local currency coverage is where these products differentiate, since the dollar corridors are well served and the difficulty lies in everything else.
